steps.label: Keep a start-of-day save
steps.text: Today's debate and short trip share a tight schedule. Read this day's instructions before committing to travel.

steps.label: Free conversations · Dia Franco Street, Altabury
steps.text: Speak to Loveless and Rudolf so their runners appear on the map.

steps.label: Free requests · Altabury
steps.text: Accept Warmth in Winter from the man outside the inn. Accept Proof of Power from the soldier near the arrival point in Opera House Square.

steps.label: Free preparation
steps.text: Accept the Icebeast Chimenzahn bounty at the Recruitment Centre. Buy the Tower of Insolence report from the informant to reveal that destination. On Lower Blue Sky Bridge, give a Medicinal Herb to the Man in Pain and keep the Tail Bait.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Set out toward Malva on a route that meets Loveless' runner. Check the encounter marker before confirming the route.

steps.label: While travelling
steps.text: Cook Amber Stew first, then take Basilio's first bond event on the runner. Complete the Loveless encounter en route.

steps.label: Village stop · Malva
steps.text: Open the shop, buy Durable Spider Silk for Warmth in Winter and return to Altabury.

steps.label: Night · free hand-in
steps.text: Give the Durable Spider Silk to the Warmth in Winter requester outside the inn. Speak to Loveless there to accept Defeat Milo, then find Milo near the Recruitment Centre to put his runner on the map.

steps.label: Night · uses time, priority
steps.text: Go to the podium on Upper Blue Sky Bridge and debate Julian. Choose “The present day matters too.” Confirm the debate trophy if all seven earlier debates were wins.

steps.label: If Julian is absent at night
steps.text: PSNProfiles shows an afternoon appearance, while the original sheet and other schedules support evening availability. Keep your morning save. Reload if necessary, complete his observed afternoon debate, and move the Malva trip plus its dependent hand-ins to the next available day. This is a conditional fallback, not a claim that he only appears today.

steps.label: Check before moving on
steps.text: Verify your actual Eloquence and Imagination ranks; the source expects both at 5 but the date does not guarantee them. Imagination 5 is needed for Basilio's later rank 6 event.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Intercept Milo's runner. Cook Enchanted Pottage and begin Literacy Workbook during the journey.

steps.label: Night · free hand-in first
steps.text: Report Defeat Milo to Loveless outside the Altabury inn.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take her rank 5 bond event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6; check Eloquence 4 and accept Wayward Shepherd.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6; requires Tolerance 5.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Intercept Rudolf's runner. Cook Indestructible Honey Cake and take Basilio's runner bond, target rank 3.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Alonzo through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7; check Courage 5.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Travel to Everfrost Forest. Cook Adamantine Honey Cake and take Junah's runner bond, target rank 6. Receive the route drawing. Defeat Icebeast Chimenzahn, collect the relic and Gold Beetle, then return.

steps.label: Cooking checkpoint
steps.text: After preparing the first 20 different runner recipes, Sublime Spoonful becomes available. Verify the menu rather than expecting an automatic unlock on this date. If it is missing, list the uncooked recipes and use later travelling slots to finish them.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the reward for the Icebeast Chimenzahn bounty.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Travel toward Scoundrel's Hold via Ligno. Visit the village shop so it counts toward the village collection. Read Literacy Workbook, second session.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Everfrost relic to Neuras, target rank 5.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Play Hexachess with Hulkenberg for Wisdom, or use a needed reading catch-up if a checkpoint remains short. Clear Scoundrel's Hold for Psyocropos; collect the relic and Gold Beetle before returning.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the Psyocropos bounty reward.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Complete the next Alonzo bond event, target rank 8. Follow the resulting request and dialogue prompts; there is a separate free follow-up scheduled on 26 September.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: During the story visit
steps.text: On the second outdoor map, after the scene overlooking the settlement, check the other branch near the fork/fountain before proceeding. Collect the Gold Beetle there. This visit is not freely repeatable, so keep a save until you have collected it.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Then follow the story.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Free requests · Grand Trad
steps.text: Accept The Edge of Glory near the MAG trader. On the west side of Sunlumeo Street, accept The Queen of Cuisine: Soul and immediately talk to its requester again to hand over Indestructible Honey Cake. Keep the Lord of the Lake reward for Sublime Spoonful.

steps.label: Free request · Brilehaven
steps.text: In Angler's Inn Square, accept Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief.

steps.label: Free request · island village
steps.text: At Dragon Statue Plaza, accept Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest.

steps.label: Free requests · Altabury
steps.text: On the east side of Upper Blue Sky Bridge, accept Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy. On the west side, accept Deliver Hot Spring Water. You are accepting the trials today, not fighting all of them now.

steps.label: Free bounty preparation
steps.text: At the Recruitment Centre, accept Ordemos, Bandit Chief Cistus and Kokamordos. Visit the relevant town informants and purchase missing destination reports. Check your map before the coming trips.

steps.label: Free collection · earlier towns
steps.text: If not already collected, recheck the Grand Trad market beetle and Martira's Cattleracket Road beetle. In Martira, inspect the sack in MesmerEyes Apothecary for the later beetle. Keep a note of which pickups you actually found.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Meet Basilio for rank 6, which needs Imagination 5. If short, report any completed More tasks first; if still blocked, use this slot for Imagination and record the delayed bond.

steps.label: Night · free follow-up
steps.text: Speak to Daturam in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square to finish the separate Alonzo follow-up. This conversation does not consume the main night activity.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Teleport to Altabury and visit the hot springs on Lower Blue Sky Bridge for Deliver Hot Spring Water. Complete any optional MAG exchange before entering. The request hand-in is tomorrow.

steps.label: Ingredient check
steps.text: Keep the rare fish reward, Gauntlet Shrooms and Queen's Honey Jars for the final new recipe. If the kitchen shows a shortage, record it now rather than using those items in duplicate dishes.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Upper Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Return the hot spring water to the requester on the west side and collect the Gold Beetle reward.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Travel to Mt. Vulkano. Cook Sublime Spoonful if all previous recipes and ingredients are ready; confirm the cooking trophy. Finish Literacy Workbook and confirm the book trophy. Clear Wayward Shepherd, collect the relic, Gold Beetle and Rusty Greatsword before returning.

steps.label: If a recipe is still missing
steps.text: Cook the missing recipe instead, keep its ingredients on your list and finish the collection on the next travel days. Do not spend the rare ingredients on unnecessary duplicate dishes.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: Give the Rusty Greatsword to The Edge of Glory requester near the MAG trader.

steps.label: Free collection reward · Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven
steps.text: If your inventory contains 46 unspent Gold Beetles, save and complete the collector's exchanges through the final reward. If you traded earlier, include those previous exchanges in your record. A short held count alone does not prove you missed a pickup; do not assume the trophy must unlock today.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7. Follow his request; the later completion requires Eloquence 5.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Scoundrel's Hold relic to Neuras, target rank 6.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8, provided his rank 7 boss was completed earlier. Otherwise this remains a recovery item for October.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Mt. Vulkano relic to Neuras, target rank 7. Accept the resulting recovery request before tomorrow's trip.

steps.label: Optional
steps.text: Check the weapon and armour sale.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Speak to the guard near Grand Trad's Recruitment Centre to locate Jin's runner.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Select Jin's runner on the map. During the journey, reread The Future of Magic. Complete the encounter and follow Neuras' recovery quest through its report/event; confirm his bond reaches rank 8.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Depart from Grand Trad toward Disgraced Ruins, reread The Future of Magic and collect the Malibelo Stope drawing on the route. Clear the Cistus bounty and collect the Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Optional training
steps.text: The dungeon has useful repeatable enemies for A-EXP. Train toward remaining study prerequisites and More's tasks; do not assume this is the single best farm for every build. Keep a save before the coming optional challenges.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town.

steps.label: Free errands
steps.text: Claim the Cistus bounty at the Recruitment Centre. Open Basilio's request in the quest log, follow its remaining marked conversations and return to him once the objective is ready.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8; check Eloquence 5 and the request completion.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Brigitta through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Archetype checkpoint
steps.text: Check which bonds, studies and ranks remain. The source's claim that everything is now available assumes you have not delayed any bonds and have completed More's chain. Focus the full mastery trophy on the protagonist; other characters' complete trees are optional.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Depart from Altabury toward Tower of Insolence. Reread The Future of Magic, collect the Decaying Estate drawing on the route, collect the Gold Beetle, clear Proof of Power and the tower's dragon trial.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: The source expects Wisdom 5 and the completed vista collection here. Confirm the actual rewards. If a drawing is missing, check the scenic routes before committing all remaining days. Show completed drawings to Maria when next in town.

steps.label: Preparation
steps.text: This is a difficult optional fight on Normal. If needed, clear the ordinary quest objective, postpone the trial and use the later free days to prepare. A guide date does not establish that your build is ready.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Opera House Square, Altabury
steps.text: Report Proof of Power to the soldier who gave you the request.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Begin the trip to Abandoned Path. Use the free runner slot for a delayed Hulkenberg or Heismay rank-up if eligible; otherwise finish a missing book/virtue activity.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Use the other available runner slot for a delayed bond or reading. Cook any missing recipe before the activity if the kitchen permits it.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: If both delayed bonds need the same period, take one now and use another short trip during the remaining free days. Do not assume two main activities fit into a single period.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Take Eupha's runner bond, target rank 8, with Wisdom 5. Clear Abandoned Path for Ordemos and collect the Gold Beetle. Finish any available cooking before the main activity.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town.

steps.label: Bond checkpoint
steps.text: Check all 14 followers in the menu. The source expects them complete now, but your delayed events take priority over optional grinding in the remaining free days.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the Ordemos bounty reward.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Clear the Skybound Avatar main objective, then return when the game permits it. Check the quest log and avoid advancing past a warning without a separate save.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Visit Manor of the Ascendant, use the travelling slot for a missing bond/virtue/book activity, defeat Kokamordos and collect the Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the Kokamordos bounty reward.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Revisit Forsaken Tower for its dragon trial. Use the journey for any remaining travel activity or cooking.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Revisit Spire of Blind Faith for its dragon trial. Use the journey for any remaining travel activity or cooking.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town. Check missing mask/vessel ingredients against Akademeia's experiment menu and the sellers' rotating stock.

steps.label: Free hand-ins first
steps.text: Check each of the three Trial of the Dragon requests in your log. Return to any requester still awaiting a report; use the 26 September pickup locations if you need to find them. Confirm the follow-up request is available before travelling.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Save separately and visit Dragon Temple for the follow-up challenge. If your party needs more preparation, use a later free day rather than forcing the fight now.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return to town and report any resulting requests.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Once your arena rank unlocks it, complete the Gold Gauntlet's 30 consecutive battles for Coliseum Champion. Bronze and Silver endurance runs are not needed to unlock Gold; progression comes from ranked matches.

steps.label: Afternoon and evening
steps.text: Recovery slots. Finish delayed follower events, missing virtue ranks or an arena match moved from August. A bond may require a day's gap before its next event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Complete the arena's Special Match and check that the ranked request chain is finished. If you changed the earlier arena schedule, follow the remaining sequence rather than expecting the same match name today.

steps.label: Combat checkpoint
steps.text: The Synthesis trophy requires 50 different skills used in battle, not 50 repetitions. For money attacks, spend at least 100,000 reeve in total; ten uses costing 9,999 leave you ten reeve short.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Prioritise unfinished requests and bonds. Keep today's start-of-day save until you know what remains.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Complete a delayed boss or dungeon, or use the town slots for bonds and virtues.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. If travel-only bonds, cooking or books remain, schedule a short runner journey and use its available activity slots.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Check all request entries and reports, including the arena and follower chains. Report completed bounties rather than leaving them pending.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Verify seven books fully read, 21 different runner dishes cooked, all followers at rank 8, five shop villages visited and the complete vista collection. The relevant trophies/menu records are better evidence than ticking a date off this document.

steps.label: Village checklist
steps.text: Komero, Inundo, Silento, Ligno and Malva. Check map locations revealed by candidate conversations and their runner encounters as well.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Complete missing experiments and train the protagonist's remaining Archetypes. Study prerequisites and mastery are separate: each required Archetype must reach rank 20 for mastery.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Finish any outstanding 50-different-Synthesis, 100 squad-ambush, 50 unscathed-win, 10 Elementa, money-skill, stealing, Gallica-chat and sword-surfing requirements. Field instant kills do not replace squad ambushes.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Check every outstanding request, relic report, optional trial and arena chain. Keep a separate save before entering any long dungeon.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Final flexible day in this schedule. Finish remaining activities that need free time. Keep tomorrow evening available for the farewell visits. Retain an older save if any completion requirement is still uncertain.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Final preparations or remaining eligible activity. Use free runner facilities if accessible.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Visit your maxed followers for their farewell items. Gallica can help you travel between them. Save separately before resting.

steps.label: Before entering
steps.text: Keep a permanent pre-finale save. Read this entry fully before fighting optional bosses in the final area.

steps.label: Trophy route
steps.text: Leave every optional boss in the final area undefeated and go to the final main objective. Defeating the final boss at full strength is the condition for Star Shatterer. Do not weaken it first. Save near the end if the game permits it.

steps.label: Optional training
steps.text: Regular enemies and the final area's tooth spawners can provide substantial rewards. If a preparation plan uses gear that repels attacks, remember that the return-run challenge has its own restrictions.

steps.label: After the required victory
steps.text: Confirm the story, full-strength and all-request trophies, then save the clear data separately. If you want to see skipped optional encounters, you may reload the pre-finale save afterwards; keep your clear data too.
